text:
Priya Rao: Hey team — quick heads up: Tanya's 30th is next Friday (May 12). Thinking we do a hybrid surprise in NYC + remote folks. Thoughts? :tada:
Alex Kim: Love it. Cake in office + donut boxes shipped to remote? :cake: :doughnut:
Jordan Lee: +1 for cake. Also maybe a small desk plant for Tanya? She likes succulents.
Mei Chen: Remote folks would like a Zoom drop-in at 3pm ET? We can do a mini roast + share a montage. I can stitch clips if people send 10s videos. :movie_camera:
Priyanka Singh: I can coordinate shipping addresses — please DM me addresses by Wednesday. Also, any dietary restrictions?
Priya Rao: Good call. Tanya's vegan, so cake should be vegan. Alex, any bakery recs near 5th Ave?
Alex Kim: There's a vegan bakery (GreenSlice) that does small tiered cakes. I can pick up and bring at 2:45pm.
Jordan Lee: I'll handle the montage — please send short clips (15–20s) with one memory or a quick wish. Deadline: Wednesday EOD.
Mei Chen: I can host the Zoom and run the surprise screen share. I'll set a 15-min calendar event and invite the team.
Priyanka Singh: Shipping list so far: 4 remote folks in EMEA, 2 in APAC. I'll order donut boxes for remote unless folks prefer something else. Suggestions?
Alex Kim: For APAC maybe a gift card is easier given shipping times. Or local bakery vouchers.
Priya Rao: OK let's do local vouchers for APAC, donut boxes for EMEA and cake in-office. Also plan a small card from the whole company (digital + signed physical).
Jordan Lee: Can someone volunteer to be photographer in-office? Need candid pics.
Alex Kim: I can take photos.
BirthdayBot: Reminder set: "Tanya 30th surprise" on 2025-05-12 14:45 ET. Invite posted by Mei Chen. :bell:
Priya Rao: @here please react with :thumbsup: if you can join the surprise Zoom at 3pm ET, or with :wave: if you'll send a video but can't make it live.
Alex Kim: :thumbsup:
Jordan Lee: :thumbsup:
Mei Chen: :thumbsup:
Priyanka Singh: :wave: (I'll be in court all afternoon but will send a clip)
Priya Rao: Thanks! Logistics checklist: Alex picks up vegan cake (2:45pm), Mei runs Zoom, Jordan compiles montage (wed EOD), Priyanka ships/arranges remote gifts. Send clips/addresses to Priyanka and me.
Alex Kim: Noted. Anything fun for decor? Balloons in conference B?
Jordan Lee: Minimal confetti (we have confetti fans, maybe avoid if anyone's allergic).
Mei Chen: I'll add a 5-min trivia about Tanya (favorite books, travel) to the montage break — send facts!
Priya Rao: OK, I'll DM a Google sheet for video uploads and address collection. Thanks all :heart: This will be fun! :party_popper:
